questions.q: In which year did Slovakia become an independent state?
questions.why: It split peacefully from the Czech Republic.

questions.q: What is the capital of Slovakia?
questions.why: It borders both Austria and Hungary.

questions.q: Which 9th-century state was centred in today's Slovakia and Moravia?
questions.why: Saints Cyril and Methodius came there.

questions.q: Which brothers brought Christianity and a Slavic script to Great Moravia?
questions.why: They arrived in 863.

questions.q: Which kingdom ruled Slovakia for about 1,000 years?
questions.why: Bratislava was the Hungarian capital for centuries.

questions.q: In which year did Slovakia join the EU and NATO?
questions.why: It adopted the euro in 2009.

questions.q: Which Slovak-born politician led the Prague Spring of 1968?
questions.why: He called it 'socialism with a human face'.

questions.q: Which scholar codified the Slovak literary language in the 1840s?
questions.why: He is a national hero.

questions.q: Which Slovak astronomer and general co-founded Czechoslovakia?
questions.why: He died in a plane crash in 1919.

questions.q: Which 1944 uprising fought the Nazis in Slovakia?
questions.why: It started in Banská Bystrica.

questions.q: Who became Slovakia's first woman President, in 2019?
questions.why: She was a lawyer and activist.

questions.q: Which legendary outlaw is called the Slovak Robin Hood?
questions.why: He was executed in 1713.

questions.q: Which city was the coronation city of Hungarian kings from 1563 to 1830?
questions.why: Kings were crowned in St Martin's Cathedral.

questions.q: Which Slovak inventor is credited with an early parachute design?
questions.why: He patented it in the USA in 1914.

questions.q: Which Slovak inventor pioneered wireless telegraphy?
questions.why: He was a priest and painter too.

questions.q: What is Slovakia's currency?
questions.why: It was adopted in 2009.

questions.q: Which mountains are Slovakia's highest?
questions.why: Gerlachovský štít is the highest peak.

questions.q: Which river flows through Bratislava?
questions.why: It also flows to Vienna and Budapest.

questions.q: Which potato dumplings with sheep's cheese are the national dish?
questions.why: They are topped with bacon.

questions.q: Which castle ruins in eastern Slovakia are among Central Europe's largest?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which Slovak ice hockey star played for the Boston Bruins?
questions.why: He was one of the tallest NHL players.

questions.q: Which fairy-tale castle in central Slovakia looks like it's from a storybook?
questions.why: It hosts a festival of ghosts.

questions.q: Which castle above the Orava River appeared in the 1922 film 'Nosferatu'?
questions.why: It sits on a high rock.

questions.q: Which cave system is famous for its ice formations?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which wooden churches in the east are a UNESCO site?
questions.why: Some were built without nails.

questions.q: Which mining town has a UNESCO-listed silver-mining heritage?
questions.why: It was once one of the largest cities in Hungary.

questions.q: Which Slovak cyclist won three world road race titles in a row?
questions.why: He won from 2015 to 2017.

questions.q: What is the tallest peak in Slovakia?
questions.why: It is 2,655 m high.

questions.q: Which village of log houses is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It is a well-preserved mountain village.

questions.q: Which traditional shepherd's flute is on UNESCO's list?
questions.why: It can be nearly two metres long.
